subject: Zoology
source_note: Compiled from the NTA/NMC NEET UG 2026 Biology syllabus (officially released 8 Jan 2026, largely unchanged from 2025 with only minor NCERT-aligned sub-topic deletions) as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources, cross-checked Sep 2026. NEET's Biology syllabus is not split into separate 'Botany' and 'Zoology' papers by NTA - both are drawn from one 90-question Biology section - but question banks and most coaching trackers conventionally split the 10 official Biology units into a Botany half and a Zoology half, which this file follows (mirrors neet_syllabus_botany.json). Digestion and Absorption was removed as a standalone examinable chapter in the 2023-24 NCERT rationalisation. Verify against the official NTA/NMC syllabus PDF for the exact unit list before finalising a bank.
exam_pattern_note: NEET UG Biology: 100 questions printed (Section A: 70 single-correct MCQs compulsory, Section B: 30 single-correct MCQs, attempt any 20 - best 20 scored), split evenly in most banks into 45 Botany-origin and 45 Zoology-origin questions of the 90 scored. Single-correct MCQ format only.
